note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace (42 mm case, Irsyad 2026-11-06: same case as SNZG11J1); heights are the SNZG11J1 ones scaled to the listed 12 mm thickness (no side view). All dial print stays in the dial map. Three-column brushed bracelet from the photo with the house 7 mm curl.

seconds.note: paddle tail (length, half width) from the trace: it lies under the hour hand

hub.note: cap = the dark pivot hole seen in the photo

lug.note: outer edge: straight line fitted to the traced edge from fit_from_y to the tip, down to where it meets the case; inner side follows an 18.9 mm arc, just outside the bezel inner edge (18.7 mm), so the lug never shows through the crystal

lume.note: light grey inlay as in the photo

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

hand_steel.note: hands, hub, collets: bright white-silver with a cool tint as in the photo (frame about sRGB 220/219/245); rougher than mirror steel so it stays light in any viewer

steel_satin.note: case, bezel and crown: fine satin finish in the photo, plain (no normal map: the lines are radial on the bezel)

steel_polished.note: bevel edges of the brushed parts

end_link.note: between the lugs from under the case: outer columns to the lug tips, centre column centre_shift shorter (photo)

bracelet.note: Three brushed columns from the photo: outer links from the lug tips, the centre column about 1 mm nearer the case; width follows the photo taper (21.5 mm at the lugs); house curl (SUR419P1), end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines along the bracelet; bevels keep the polished material
